$comment: External assets this project imports through CNA's glTF pipeline.
The files themselves are NOT committed. Every one of them is a 4K-textured
product-shot asset and the set runs to about 110 MB, which is a third of a
gigabyte of git history for props seen through a shop window. They are fetched
instead, exactly as the sibling framework checkouts are, and verified against the
checksums here. A tree that has not fetched them simply has no imported props:
every one of them has a procedural fallback, which is the same contract the
compiled texture content already has.
Every entry is CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0. Nothing here is used on the strength of the
repository it came from: the licence recorded below is the one stated for that
individual model in KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets' own Models.md, which does
carry models under other terms -- the Duck is SCEA, Sponza is a CRYENGINE
agreement, Virtual City is a testing-only 3DRT licence, and none of those is
here.
Two further kinds of entry, both from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), whose whole
library is CC0-1.0: models that ship as a .gltf, a .bin and a folder of images
(declared with a `files` list rather than one `file`), and scanned PBR texture
sets under `surfaces`, each replacing one generated surface of the catalogue
by name. A surface declares its physical size and the tile size the geometry
lays it at, so the content build can write the UV scale that keeps a brick
the size of a brick. Nothing under downloads/ is committed.

assets.name: cesium-man
assets.title: Cesium Man
assets.author: Cesium
transformations: compiled to .cnb by cna_tool_gltf_to_cnb during the content build
uniformly scaled at placement to the real-world size given by fitMetres
assets.role: The imported-skeleton round trip: compiled to .cnb by CNA's own glTF importer and loaded back at start-up, where its 19-bone skeleton, bind pose, inverse bind pose and animation clip are read into a SkinningData and driven by CNA's AnimationPlayer. Not placed in the crowd -- the mesh does not draw through SkinnedPbrEffect and the reason is unresolved; see docs/cna-findings.md GLTF-207 and GLTF-208.
